about: A one-handed sword: a two-edged blade with a guard, a grip and a pommel. Today the arming sword, the only weapon with its own fight.

lead.source: D463: the main hand, the left on a left-handed body (holding.md Mirroring)

grip_type.source: D562: in hand, a power grip closed by touch on the grip

slots.name: blade
slots.joins: its shoulder (the tang's section at the blade's base, flat) takes the guard's slot; its tang runs down -Y, the handle made round it to the tang's end

slots.name: grip
slots.joins: a wrapped grip round the tang from under the guard to the pommel, its length the blade's tang less both

slots.name: guard
slots.joins: its slot on the blade's shoulder; it covers the blade's base and the grip's top

slots.name: pommel
slots.joins: its bore on the tang's end, below the grip

grip.how: the middle of the code-made grip between the guard and the pommel (D546's blade rule): the item's origin

second.how: held in one hand; a longsword held in two is another kind, with its own takes

edge.how: the blade's edge points (edge.lower at the shoulder, edge.upper at the tip, both edges, ±Z) carried through; the hit segment from the guard to the tip, replacing contact.rs's fixed 0.15 to 0.83 m

held.how: in the main hand's socket, flats ±X; the guard of sword.shielded (Low_Guard, with a shield) over locomotion by the hold layer

open.why: the sword alone (sword.single) has no guard of its own yet; D461 orders it after two-handed

used.how: sword.shielded's slash, backhand and heavy (Open_Slash, Open_Backhand, Open_Heavy)

open.why: the keyed takes snap the wrist 39 to 90 degrees in a key and bend it past human range, and the slash leads with one edge, the heavy with the flat: remade first (assembled-items.md, Must be fixed first; D565 step 3)

carried.how: in the one-handed tool's carry pose, its tip forward and down (attachment.md Carried)

stowed.how: a one-handed blade at the hip away from the main hand, mirrored for a left-handed body

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step); whether a scabbard shows is a belt look not made

blocking.how: with a shield, the shield blocks (sword.shielded's Clear_Block); alone, in the Single stance, a guard on the blade, weaker than a shield (D567)

open.why: sword.single and its block clip, and how much weaker its block is, are not built (the combat skill)

animation.how: sword.shielded (assets/data/moves/sword.shielded.ron), the only set; sword.single and sword.dual none yet

open.why: sword.single after the two-handed stance (D461's order); sword.dual (D462) after

length_m.source: assets/data/items.ron hold.length; the look's bounds measured 0.951

open.why: items.ron gives the whole sword only; the blade's share is its part's, weighed when made (step 2)

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: a sword's grip about 3 cm across (recalled); measured on the reference's grip when made

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

length_m.source: the reference's length ±10% (research/2026-10-28-assembled-items-animation.md section 1: tip 0.76 to 0.93 m inside the clamp; blades of 0.60 to 1.05 m gave no new fault)

open.why: the blade's reference mass is open (above); for the whole sword the band is 0.91 to 1.66 kg at its balance

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: length measured through sword.shielded's clips on every body (research section 1); masses from items.ron's stand-in
